documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM
Addendum To The Boards'' Report For The Financial Year 2025-26 Which Forms An Integral Part Of The 34Th Annual Report

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited published its Investor Presentation for Q1 FY 2026-27, detailing strong operational performance, significant order book position, and manufacturing capabilities. The company reported robust revenue and profitability growth alongside ongoing capacity expansions and working capital enhancements. Furthermore, management outlined strategic business diversification plans into new technological and infrastructure domains. Kernex Microsystems reported strong financial growth for Q3 FY25 and 9M FY25, driven by higher revenue from operations and improved gross contribution and EBITDA margins. The company highlighted its ongoing production capacity for Kavach units and Level Crossing Gates, along with details of various railway safety projects and bids submitted.
